§10.2 INDEPENDENT REIMPLEMENTATION of ssrn.5895159 publicly-described concepts (Micro-Martingale decomposition + Integral Take-Profit) from abstract + UUUB summary ONLY. Full-text PDF Cloudflare-blocked, so NOT a verified implementation (§10.2 disclosure: blocked_unverified_source). Implemented as TpMode::MicroIntegral{close_frac}: closes close_frac of position per qualifying profit-bar. 540-cell sweep (close_frac[0.1-1.0] × tp_bps[3-20] × adverse[0.005-0.020] × legs[2-4] × fo[35-65]) on full 1066d BTC. FINDINGS: NO config reaches Sharpe>=2.0. Best Sharpe=1.725 (cf=0.75,tp_bps=3) but ann=0.57% (near-zero return). Best ann=29.32% (cf=1.0=full-close) but Sharpe=0.874. STRICT TRADEOFF: MicroIntegral raises Sharpe by killing ann. Conclusion: the paper's concepts, even faithfully reimplemented, cannot reach the target tiers (Sharpe>=2 AND ann>=50%). The Sharpe/ann frontier is the binding constraint, not the TP mechanism.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: M1M2 AND-gate re-tested on EXTENDED 731-day bookDepth window (downloaded 1808 new depth files, 5 symbols, 2023-07 to 2025-06). Prior Sharpe 2.0185 was a SHORT-WINDOW ARTIFACT (219d) — on the full window the Sharpe collapses to 0.756. 16-cell grid (fo[15-50] × thresh[0.5-1.5]) on 1066d: best ann=23.60% (fo=50,th=0.8) but Sharpe=0.756, DD=35.59%. No config reaches Sharpe>=2.0 or ann>=50% with DD<=20% on the full window. CONCLUSION: the M2 AND-gate does NOT add independent alpha — it only filters trades, which inflates apparent Sharpe on short windows but not on the full window. PBO remains 0.82-0.99 (symbol returns correlated). This closes the M1M2 path definitively: it is NOT a route to the target tiers. Artifact: r8/gates/r8-m1m2-extended.json (if written)

Sharpe is reporting-only (line 493). 162-cell tier_push sweep (FO[35-130]×leverage[2-4]×adverse×tp_bps×legs) on full 1066d BTC: ALL 162 cells MISS all 3 tiers. Best ann=38.96% (fo=65%) but DD=51.18%>30%. FO ceiling at 80% (reserve gate: next_so=fo*1.25 must fit equity; fo<=65% viable). Leverage has NO effect on reserve gate (it checks notional, not margin). Hard-gate audit on best config: Gates 3 (>=5 base assets) and 4 (single symbol <=50%) FAIL (single-symbol config). Multi-symbol required but multi-symbol ann is lower (23.60%). DEFINITIVE: ann cannot reach 50% within any DD gate. The Martin M1 signal's empirical ann/DD frontier caps at ~35% ann / ~40% DD — structurally below the 50/90/110% targets.
